annualElectricityKwh.description: Annual electricity use in kWh (used if TOE is unknown; 1,000 TOE ≈ 11.6 million kWh).

annualEmissionsTco2e.description: Annual GHG emissions in tonnes CO2e.

annualEnergyToe.description: Annual energy use in TOE (tonnes of oil equivalent).

tools.description: Indicative CBAM certificate cost for the EU importer: embedded emissions (default value with mark-up, or the producer's actual SEE) minus the free-allocation adjustment (Reg 2025/2620 benchmark × CBAM factor 97.5 % in 2026 × CSCF), times the official certificate price (latest quarterly price unless given). Shows the saving with actual data.

actual_see.description: Producer's actual specific embedded emissions, tCO2e/t (verified), instead of the default value.

carbon_price_paid_eur_per_t.description: Carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin, EUR per tCO2e embedded (none for Viet Nam in 2026).

certificate_price_eur.description: CBAM certificate price EUR/tCO2e (default: latest official quarterly price).

country.description: ISO-2 country of production, default VN.

tonnes.description: Net mass imported into the EU, tonnes.

tools.description: GHG inventory from activity data, reported by ISO 14064-1 category (1-6), GHG Protocol scope and gas: fuels (IPCC 2006 tier-1 defaults; litres, kg, t, GJ, MWh…; stationary or mobile), purchased electricity (give the official grid factor of the year — no default built in), refrigerant / SF6 recharges (GWP AR5 or AR6), and custom lines with your own factor (Scope 3 via scope3_category). Biogenic CO2 reported separately; optional uncertainty.

gwp.description: GWP set (AR5 for Vietnam Decree 06 and EU CBAM; default AR5).

factor_kg_co2e_per_unit.description: Custom factor, kg CO2e per unit of quantity.

fuel.description: diesel, gasoline, fuel_oil, lpg, natural_gas, kerosene, anthracite, bituminous_coal, sub_bituminous_coal, wood, other_solid_biomass (rice husk, bagasse). Vietnamese: dầu DO = diesel, dầu FO = fuel_oil, xăng = gasoline, gas / khí hoá lỏng = lpg, than cám / than antraxit = anthracite, trấu = other_solid_biomass.

grid_ef_t_per_mwh.description: Electricity: official grid emission factor, tCO2e/MWh.

quantity.description: JSON number in the given unit. Convert Vietnamese writing first (dot = thousands, comma = decimals): "1.050 lít" -> 1050, "1.220 MWh" -> 1220, "3,2 tấn" -> 3.2. A string such as "1.050" is refused as ambiguous unless number_format is set.

unit.description: fuel: L, m3, kg, t, GJ, TJ, MWh, kWh, mmBtu; electricity: kWh, MWh, GJ; refrigerant: kg, t; custom: any.

use.description: Fuel use (CH4/N2O factors), default stationary. mobile = road vehicles; off_road = forklifts, construction / farm machinery (IPCC Table 3.3.1, diesel or gasoline).

number_format.description: Only for quantities sent as strings: vi = "1.050,5" style (dot thousands), en = "1,050.5" style. Ambiguous strings without it are refused.
